title: How a request moves through the agent platform

views.title: The platform
views.text: Clients come in at the top, the agent runtime works in the middle, and results land in storage.
views.notes: Start with the whole picture. Fifteen services in five rows.

views.title: Inside the agent runtime
views.text: The agent keeps its memory beside it and calls the model directly.
views.notes: Memory is pgvector; the model API is the one external dependency on the hot path.

views.title: One request, step by step
views.text: A chat message reaches the gateway, the agent runs it, and asks the model.
